offer.text: The rushed survey smudged, but its bones are sound. Bring me 6 paper and I'll redraw what we lost — take all the time you need this round.

accept.text: Patience makes a truer map than haste ever did.

decline.text: The smudge will keep. So will I.

in_progress.text: Whenever the paper's ready, friend. No deadline this time.

ready.text: Fresh sheets — now I can salvage the ridge lines.

complete.text: Redrawn and better for it. The frontier's still out there waiting — shall we?
